units.name: Gus Machado College of Business
units.evidence: Official university names actual Gus Machado College of Business and its MBA provision. University-linked formal MBA Supply Chain Management specialization explicitly covers logistics and operations management with 12 specialization credits. College host retained; no invented compound department.

decisions.reason: Long compound teaching-subject list is not an official department identified in opened evidence. Actual college independently verified with formal supply-chain MBA specialization.

sources.note: Entire current undergraduate/master’s/postmaster’s/doctoral table read. Supply Chain Management MBA and Trade/Logistics undergraduate provision; engineering is pre-engineering pathway only. Doctorates Administration, Ethical Leadership, nursing, sports and theology/leadership, no Ops/IE research doctorate identified. Miami Gardens Florida address confirms namesake distinction.
Exact Gus Machado College of Business and St. Thomas University Miami identity read; actual college offers MBA and programmes, no compound subject department named in opened page.

Exact Doctor of Business Administration read, 60 credits, applied scholar-practitioner research, Management/Sports Administration/Cyber Security specializations. Action research, dissertation or journal articles are alternatives. DBA retained as DBA and not converted into PhD; no qualifying Ops specialization.
Actual Doctor of Philosophy in Ethical Leadership programme read, specializations Criminal Justice and Higher Education. Generic organizational effectiveness and leadership are not an Ops/IE field.

University-linked official online MBA Supply Chain Management page read: 30 credits and 12 specialization credits, explicitly logistics, operations management, import/export and supply value-chain optimization. Formal specialization establishes substantive college scope beyond a single general core course. Partner-maintained page states STU retains academic/curriculum responsibility.

limitations: Miami Gardens Florida St. Thomas University only; Minnesota University of St. Thomas and Canadian namesakes not merged.
No named standalone Ops/SCM department established; actual college-level host retained.
